channel.title: Finault API Changelog
channel.description: Updates, features, and improvements to the Finault API

item.title: Webhook signature verification timeout fixed
item.description: Fixed race condition in webhook signing verification that could cause occasional validation failures on high-throughput systems.

item.title: Intelligence Report exports now available
item.description: Added ability to export Intelligence Reports in CSV, JSON, and PDF formats with configurable date ranges and metrics.

item.title: Finault Score calculation improved
item.description: Updated scoring algorithm to better account for marginal cost changes and adjusted the weighting of cost optimization vs risk factors.

item.title: AIEI receipt validation fixed
item.description: Fixed JSON schema validation for AIEI receipts that was rejecting valid custom metadata fields.

item.title: Idempotency key support added
item.description: All POST endpoints now support Idempotency-Key header to prevent duplicate processing on network retries.

item.title: Legacy v1/decisions endpoint deprecated
item.description: The v1/decisions endpoint is deprecated in favor of v1/decisions/sync and v1/decisions/async. Legacy support will be removed in version 4.0.

item.title: Close Pack processing optimized
item.description: Improved Close Pack batch processing speed by 40% through optimized database queries and parallel processing of independent reconciliations.

item.title: Webhook request signing added
item.description: Webhooks now include HMAC-SHA256 signature in X-Finault-Signature header for secure validation of event authenticity.

item.title: Intelligence Report date boundaries fixed
item.description: Fixed off-by-one error in Intelligence Report generation that was excluding events on the end date.

item.title: Finault Score percentile calculation adjusted
item.description: Adjusted percentile bucket sizes for Finault Score to provide more granular scoring distribution across customer cohorts.

item.title: Batch decision limits increased
item.description: Increased maximum batch size for v1/decisions/batch from 100 to 500 decisions per request.

item.title: Close Pack v2 API released
item.description: Released new Close Pack API with support for partial reconciliations, incremental updates, and idempotent operations.

item.title: AIEI receipt timestamp precision fixed
item.description: Fixed millisecond truncation in AIEI receipt timestamps that was causing timestamp mismatches in high-volume scenarios.

item.title: EU AI Act compliance reporting enhanced
item.description: Enhanced compliance reporting to include decision rationale and audit trail for EU AI Act transparency requirements.

item.title: Webhook event filtering added
item.description: Added ability to configure which event types trigger webhook calls, reducing unnecessary traffic and improving system efficiency.

item.title: Intelligence Report memory leak fixed
item.description: Fixed memory leak in Intelligence Report generation for reports spanning more than 30 days of data.

item.title: Finault Score ranking algorithm updated
item.description: Introduced normalized comparative scoring to better account for differences in customer scale and transaction patterns.

item.title: Rate limiting transparency added
item.description: Added X-RateLimit-* headers to all API responses showing remaining quota and reset time.

item.title: Legacy webhook format deprecated
item.description: Legacy webhook format (v1) is deprecated. Migrate to v2 format before June 2026.

item.title: AIEI receipt caching issue fixed
item.description: Fixed caching behavior that could return stale AIEI receipts for concurrent requests within the same second.

item.title: Close Pack reconciliation timeout increased
item.description: Increased timeout for Close Pack reconciliation from 30s to 60s to accommodate larger batches.

item.title: Intelligence Reports GA
item.description: General availability of Intelligence Reports feature for all enterprise customers. Includes automated report generation, custom metrics, and scheduled delivery.

item.title: API response encoding fixed
item.description: Fixed UTF-8 encoding issue in API responses that could truncate special characters in metadata fields.

item.title: Webhook retry exponential backoff implemented
item.description: Implemented exponential backoff for failed webhook deliveries with configurable retry policy.

item.title: Finault Score baseline updated
item.description: Updated baseline metrics for Finault Score calculation based on Q4 2025 customer cohort data.

item.title: Close Pack null value handling fixed
item.description: Fixed handling of null values in Close Pack reconciliation that could cause validation errors.

item.title: Compliance audit logging added
item.description: Added comprehensive audit logging for all compliance-related API calls including decision rationale and regulatory references.

item.title: AIEI receipt schema validation fixed
item.description: Fixed JSON schema validation to properly handle nested objects in AIEI receipt metadata.

item.title: Deprecated v1/health/legacy endpoint removed
item.description: Removed v1/health/legacy endpoint. Use v1/health instead.

item.title: Intelligence Report performance optimized
item.description: Optimized Intelligence Report query performance for accounts with >1M decisions by introducing time-range indexing.

item.title: Webhook delivery ordering fixed
item.description: Fixed race condition that could cause webhook events to be delivered out of order during high concurrency.

item.title: Finault Score released
item.description: Launched new Finault Score metric providing normalized profitability ranking across customer cohorts with daily updates.
